Adding staging ops detail and initial timeline adjustments after infra sync:

Staging milestones (ops scope):
- Provisioning validation (day 0-1): confirm GPU models, driver stack, and kernel selection matches perf profile
- Burn-in & telemetry (day 2-4): synthetic load to validate continuous batching and KV cache persistence across preempt/restart events
- Model variant smoke (day 5): deploy candidate quantized variant + run 1k sample prompts against golden set for quality regression check
- Ramp window (day 6-10): ramp API traffic from 10% -> 70% over 4 business days, observe latency p95 and error budget

Commissioning constraints: we need a 6-hour blackout-free soak every night during ramp for KV cache finalization; customer must enable a test feed. I attached the commissioning checklist and KV warm-up plan.

Action owners:
- Marcus: lead throughput validation and provide acceptance metrics template (Marcus will attach)
- Karthik: confirm procurement billing entity and DocuSign routing
- Neha: coordinate final go/no-go and confirm windows with Grundex

Attaching acceptance metrics and a short checklist for the validation run. Key acceptance gates I’ll watch:
- p95 latency <= 180ms under steady-state 60% traffic
- Error rate < 0.5% (5xx + timeouts)
- Token cost per request delta within agreed band vs hosted baseline
- Model quality regression: BLEU/ROUGE proxies + 50 prompt human spot-checks

If these gates pass in the canary, we flip routing tier-by-tier (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and hold each level for 6 hours. If any gate fails, we automatically rollback to hosted and open a postmortem.

Marcus Lin
Head of Runtime Reliability
Redwood Inference
